name: Mourning Gargoyle
description: A roof guardian brought below ground after its chapel fell. It crouches over an imaginary roof edge and bares its stone teeth at passing lights.

abilities.description: Starts combat with 6 block. Absorbed damage spends it permanently for this fight.
Reduces incoming physical damage by 15 percent using the shared resistance rules.
